claims: Artemis II is conducting a 10-day crewed flight test around the Moon.
Artemis II marks the first human mission to deep space in over 50 years.
Artemis II had a successful launch on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II crew consists of four persons.
The Artemis II crew is verifying the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems.
The Artemis II crew is performing manual piloting tests in high-Earth orbit.
